kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أختلب (form VIII)
# أَخْتَلِبُ (ʔaḵtalibu) /ʔax.ta.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# أُخْتَلَبُ (ʔuḵtalabu) /ʔux.ta.la.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# أَخْتَلِبَ (ʔaḵtaliba) /ʔax.ta.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# أُخْتَلَبَ (ʔuḵtalaba) /ʔux.ta.la
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
